CHAT.TITLE: Ask your question
CHAT.HELLO: Hello! What would you like to do? Type your question, or pick one below.

CENTER.SUPPORT_TEXT: Didn't find your answer? Contact technical support.

ZERO.Q: Why are some blocks empty or showing 0?
ZERO.A: Each block is loaded separately. If one of them could not be loaded, a red message at the top of the page says so: reload the page. Otherwise there is simply no data in your scope (your entity, or every entity for a multi-country administrator).

FILTER.Q: How do I see the workforce of a single department?
FILTER.A: Click a statistics card (workforce, jobs or seniority). In the window that opens, pick the department. This filter only applies to the window: the page's cards keep showing everything.

COUNTRY.Q: Why can't I see the country picker?
COUNTRY.A: The country picker only appears for administrators who have access to several countries. Other users only see their own entity's data.

DOCS.Q: How do I complete an employee's missing documents?
DOCS.A: The « Missing documents » card lists incomplete files by urgency. Then open the employee's profile from the « Profiles » menu to add the missing documents.

SHORTCUT.Q: What are the quick actions for?
SHORTCUT.A: They are shortcuts to the most used screens: requests, onboarding, leaves to handle and recruitment. The requests counter shows those waiting to be handled.

PROBATION.Q: Where can I see probation periods ending soon?
PROBATION.A: In the « Watchlist » card, the « End of probation » block lists the upcoming deadlines with the days left (D-…). To validate one, open the employee's profile, « Contracts » tab, then « Validate probation ».

NEWCOMERS.Q: Where can I see new joiners and birthdays?
NEWCOMERS.A: At the bottom of the home page: « New employees » shows the latest arrivals with their onboarding progress, and « Birthdays this month » the upcoming birthdays.

COMPLETION.Q: What does the « Profile completion » rate mean?
COMPLETION.A: It is the overall fill rate of HR profiles, with the number of records still incomplete. To raise it, open those profiles from « Profiles » and complete them; the « Missing documents » card shows which to handle first.

LEFT.Q: I can't find an employee who left the company. Why?
LEFT.A: By default the list only shows the current workforce (active, on leave, on mission). Open « Advanced filters » and tick « Include departed profiles » to also see pre-onboarding, offboarding, departed and archived profiles. You can also pick a status directly.

COUNTERS.Q: Why don't the Profiles counters change when I filter?
COUNTERS.A: The four counters at the top only follow the Country filter. The search and the other filters (department, grade, status, contract, hire date) only change the list.

EDIT.Q: Why can't I see the « Edit » pencil icon?
EDIT.A: It only appears if you are allowed to edit profiles. Without that right you can only view files. Ask your administrator for it if you need it.

NO_FILE.Q: An employee has no HR file yet. What should I do?
NO_FILE.A: The list also shows accounts that have no HR file yet. For them, the eye icon is replaced by a « person + » icon (« Create HR profile ») that opens the file creation, provided you are allowed to create profiles. The file is usually created by the Candidate → Onboarding process.

EXPORT.Q: How do I export a list of employees?
EXPORT.A: Tick the cards you want, then click « Export Excel » in the bar that appears at the bottom. You get a CSV file (opens in Excel) with the name, email, country, status and hire date. The export covers the page on screen: show more cards per page to export more.

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in Profiles kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes. When you come back from a file, the list restores your search, filters, sort, page and display (grid or list).

CREATE.Q: How do I create a profile for a new employee?
CREATE.A: There is no « New profile » button: the HR profile is created by the recruitment flow (Candidate → IT & Onboarding → Hired). If the person already has an account without a profile, they show in the list with the « Create HR profile » icon: fill in the country, contract type and hire date (and the end date for a fixed-term contract), then « Create record ». You need the right to create profiles.

NEW_HIDDEN.Q: I just created a profile and can't find it in the list. Why?
NEW_HIDDEN.A: A new record is in « Pre-onboarding », and by default the list only shows people in service. Open « Advanced filters » and tick « Include departed profiles » to find it, or move it to « Active » with « Change status » on its profile.

EMAIL.Q: How do I send an email to several employees?
EMAIL.A: Tick the profiles you want, then click « Bulk Email » in the bar that appears at the bottom: your mail app opens with their addresses. The selection covers the page shown.

BANK_TAB.Q: Why don't I see the « Bank details » tab?
BANK_TAB.A: This tab, like « Document history », is only shown to HR managers and administrators, because it holds confidential data.

SAVE.Q: Why does saving the file show an error?
SAVE.A: The « Reason for the change » is required: describe what you are changing in a few words (for example « Contact details update »), then click « Save changes » again.

LOST.Q: Are my changes kept when I switch tabs?
LOST.A: Yes: editing covers the whole file, and a dot marks the edited tabs. They are lost if you click « Cancel » or leave the page before saving.

SALARY.Q: Where do I change the salary?
SALARY.A: In the « Remuneration » tab, which has its own « Save » button and a required « Reason for Change ». The salary shown in « Employment & role » can no longer be edited there.

ATTESTATION.Q: How do I generate a work certificate?
ATTESTATION.A: Open the « HR Documents » panel with the arrow tab on the right edge of the screen, then click « Generate » next to the certificate you need. It then appears under « Generated documents », ready to download.

DISABLED.Q: Why is a certificate greyed out?
DISABLED.A: The permanent-staff certificate is for employees on a CDI only, and the salary-domiciliation one needs bank details filled in. The hover message gives the reason.

CONTRACT.Q: Why don't I see « Renew CDD » or « Convert to CDI »?
CONTRACT.A: These actions only appear if you are allowed to edit profiles, and only on an active, unlocked contract: « Renew CDD » and « Convert to CDI » for a CDD, « Validate probation » during probation. For a CIVP, conversion starts with « Request move to CDI ».

OFFBOARDING.Q: How do I record a resignation?
OFFBOARDING.A: If you manage departures, click « Start offboarding » at the bottom of the identity card, pick the departure type, then « Open the case ». Dates, notice and the supporting document are entered afterwards in the offboarding file.

STATUS.Q: How do I change an employee's status?
STATUS.A: Click « Change status » at the bottom of the identity card, pick the new status (for example « Active » or « On mission »), enter the reason, which is required, then confirm. The button only shows with the right to edit profiles.

PHOTO.Q: How do I change the employee's photo?
PHOTO.A: Click the camera icon on the identity card's photo and pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of 3 MB at most. The icon only shows with the right to edit profiles.

DOCUMENT.Q: How do I add a document to the record?
DOCUMENT.A: In the « Documents » tab, drop the file (PDF, JPG or PNG) in the « Import a document » area of the right type. The document arrives as « To verify »; the icons on its row then let you verify, reject, edit (its expiry date, for example) or remove it.

NEW_CONTRACT.Q: How do I add a new contract?
NEW_CONTRACT.A: In the « Contracts » tab, click « New contract », pick the type and start date (and the expected end date for a fixed-term contract), then « Create contract ». Leave the notice period empty to use the grade's default. You need the right to edit profiles.

IT.Q: How do I assign or take back IT equipment?
IT.A: In the « IT equipment » tab: « Assign » adds an item, « Return » records its return, and « Sync » picks up the equipment handed over during IT provisioning. These buttons only show with the right to manage equipment.

CREATE.Q: How do I add a candidate from the HR Pipeline?
CREATE.A: Click « New candidate » at the top right of the page and fill in the form. The button only appears if you are allowed to create candidates.

MOVE.Q: How do I move a candidate to the next step?
MOVE.A: In the kanban view, drag their card to the next column: « Pending » → « Accepted » accepts them, « Accepted » → « IT & Onboarding » opens the IT Provisioning page, « IT & Onboarding » → « Hired » opens their onboarding. To reject them, drag them from « Pending » to « Rejected ».

REFUSED.Q: Why is my card move refused?
REFUSED.A: Each column is a real step of the process, and none can be skipped. Only a « Pending » candidate can be accepted or rejected, IT provisioning is done on its own page, and hiring goes through onboarding. The message shown above the board tells you which step to take.

ACCEPT.Q: I don't see the « Accept » and « Reject » icons. Why?
ACCEPT.A: They only appear for « Pending » candidates, in the list view or on mobile, and only if you are allowed to accept or reject candidates. Ask your administrator for this right if you need it.

COUNTERS.Q: Why don't the HR Pipeline counters change when I filter?
COUNTERS.A: The three counters at the top cover all recruitment. Search and filters only change the board or the list.

OFFBOARDING.A: It only appears if you manage departures. It shows departures in progress (closed files are not listed): click a card to open the file. It is not a recruitment step, so a candidate cannot be dragged into it.

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in the HR Pipeline kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes, when you open a candidate's file and come back: the view, search, filters, sort and page are restored. If you go through another page of the application, they are reset.

REJECT.Q: How do I reject a candidate?
REJECT.A: Only a « Pending » candidate can be rejected: drag their card to « Rejected » in kanban view, or click the ✗ « Reject » icon in list view. A reason of at least 10 characters is required.

HIRE.Q: How do I hire a candidate and make them an employee?
HIRE.A: Move them column by column: « Pending » → « Accepted », then « IT & Onboarding », which opens the IT provisioning page, then « Hired », which opens their onboarding. This flow is what creates their profile in « Profiles ».

DEMAND.Q: How do I link a candidate to an open position?
DEMAND.A: In the « New Candidate » form, pick the position in « Hiring request »: the position, department and desired start date are filled in. Without an approved request for your entity, the application stays unsolicited.

VIEW.Q: How do I switch between kanban and list view?
VIEW.A: With the two icons to the right of the search bar. The list view has pagination and the « Accept » / « Reject » icons; your choice is kept when you come back from a candidate's page.

CREATE.Q: How do I add a candidate from the Candidates page?
CREATE.A: Click « New Candidate » top right and fill in the form. Pick the position in « Hiring request » to link it to an open position; otherwise the application is unsolicited. The button only shows with the right to create candidates.

DIFFERENCE.Q: What is the difference between « Candidates » and « HR Pipeline »?
DIFFERENCE.A: « Candidates » follows the hiring stages (screening, interview, offer, recruited) and the offers. « HR Pipeline » follows the candidate's status: that is where you accept or reject them by dragging their card, then move on to IT and onboarding. On « Candidates », cards can't be dragged.

REJECTED.A: They are not on this page, which only shows ongoing applications. Find them in « HR Pipeline », « Rejected » column.

INTERVIEW.Q: How do I schedule an interview?
INTERVIEW.A: Open the candidate's page (click their card), « Interviews » tab, then « Schedule »: pick the type, date, time and place. The candidate then moves to the « Interview » column, where their card shows the next interview (or « Interview to schedule »).

OFFER.Q: How do I send an offer to a candidate?
OFFER.A: The candidate must first be accepted after their interviews. Then click the « Send an offer » icon on their card, or open their page, « Offer » tab. The offer is costed there with the salary simulator and must be approved by finance before it is sent.

ANSWER.Q: The candidate answered the offer: what now?
ANSWER.A: On their card in the « Offer » column (« Awaiting signature »): « Accept the offer » if they accepted, and they move to IT provisioning; « Renegotiate » to make a new proposal from the « Offer » tab; « Refuse the offer » if they declined, with the refusal reason.

URGENT.Q: What does « Urgent » on a card mean?
URGENT.A: The candidate's expected start date is close. The « Urgent Positions » counter counts them, and the « Urgent only (start date soon) » filter shows only them, to handle them first.

DELAY.Q: What does « Avg. Recruitment Time » mean?
DELAY.A: It is the average number of days a hiring takes. Up to 15 days it reads « Excellent pace »; from 16 to 30 days, « Within range »; beyond that, « Exceeds target ».

SORT.Q: How are candidates ordered (« Fit » score)?
SORT.A: By « Fit » score, highest first; candidates without a score are at the bottom. The column header arrow reverses the order. The « Minimum fit score » filter hides those under 50, 70 or 85%.

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in Candidates kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes, when you open a candidate's page and come back: the view, search, filters and sort are restored. They are reset if you go through another page or reload the page.

REQUIRED.Q: Which fields are required to create a candidate?
REQUIRED.A: First name, last name and a valid email (step 1), then the contract type and start date (step 2). Everything else is optional and can be completed later on the candidate's page.

NEXT.Q: Why is the « Next » button greyed out?
NEXT.A: A required field of the step is missing or wrong: the message under the form says which (an email in the wrong format, for example). As soon as it is fixed, the button is active again.

DEMAND.Q: What does picking a « Hiring request » fill in?
DEMAND.A: The position, start date, department, grade and discipline, only when they are still empty: what you already typed is never overwritten. The experience level starts at the minimum the position asks for, to adjust. Without an approved request for your entity, the application stays spontaneous.

CV.A: PDF, DOC or DOCX, 10 MB at most. The CV is optional. If its upload fails when saving, the candidate is still created: add the CV from their page.

SALARY.Q: What are the HR budget and salary information for?
SALARY.A: It is optional. If you enter the « HR budget (net) », saving also sends a cost estimate to finance, so they see the hiring coming. It is not an offer: the offer will be costed and approved later. The estimate can be redone from the « Compensation » tab of the candidate's page.

NATIONALITY.Q: Why do I only see two nationalities?
NATIONALITY.A: Candidates are hired for the Tunisian and Egyptian entities: the list only offers those two nationalities.

QUALITY.A: The share of information filled in, CV included. It does not prevent saving: a more complete profile is simply more useful to managers.

SAVED.Q: Is what I type saved between steps?
SAVED.A: No: nothing is saved before « Save the profile », on the last step. « Previous » keeps what you typed, but « Cancel » or leaving the page loses it.

AFTER.Q: What happens after « Save the profile »?
AFTER.A: The candidate is created as « Pending » and their page opens: you can schedule their interviews there. They also show on the « Candidates » and « HR Pipeline » pages.

ACCEPT.Q: How do I accept or reject a candidate from their file?
ACCEPT.A: For a « Pending » candidate, the « Accept » and « Reject » buttons are top right, if you have the right to accept or reject candidates. Rejecting asks for a reason of at least 10 characters.

EDIT.Q: How do I edit the candidate's information?
EDIT.A: Click « Edit » at the bottom of the identity card: the identity and the Profile tab become editable. First name, last name and email stay required; « Save » in the bottom bar applies the changes. You need the onboarding right, and a hired candidate is no longer edited here.

TABS.A: They depend on the stage and your rights: « Offer » and « IT provisioning » only show once the candidate is accepted, « Interviews » is hidden for a rejected or archived candidate, and « Compensation » only shows with the right to hire or for an administrator.

INTERVIEW_RESULT.Q: How do I record an interview's result?
INTERVIEW_RESULT.A: In the « Interviews » tab, on the scheduled interview, pick « Passed » or « Failed » (or cancel it), add your notes and confirm. You need the right to manage interviews.

OFFER_STEPS.Q: How do I prepare and send an offer from the file?
OFFER_STEPS.A: « Offer » tab: « Prepare the offer », enter the proposed salary, « Cost it », then « Submit for approval ». Finance approves the cost; only then, « Send to candidate ». An offer is only possible once the candidate is accepted.

SEND_BLOCKED.Q: Why is sending the offer blocked (finance approval)?
SEND_BLOCKED.A: The offer is waiting for finance's budget approval (« Awaiting budget approval »). If the cost is refused, finance may make a counter-proposal: revise the offer and submit it again.

HIRE.Q: How do I hire the candidate?
HIRE.A: The « Hire » button shows when the candidate is accepted or in onboarding, with the right to hire. Enter the hire date (and the end date for a fixed-term contract, CIVP, internship or secondment), then « Confirm hire »: their employee profile is created and opens.

CV.Q: How do I add or replace the CV?
CV.A: « CV » tab: « Add a CV » or « Replace », with a PDF, DOC or DOCX file of 10 MB at most. « Download » gets the current CV.

SALARY_TAB.Q: Why don't I see the « Compensation » tab?
SALARY_TAB.A: It holds budget data: it only shows to people with the right to hire and to administrators.

IT.Q: Where do I follow the candidate's IT preparation?
IT.A: In the « IT provisioning » tab, once accepted: account, equipment and licences. With the IT right, « Manage provisioning » opens the IT file to complete it.

ORIGIN.Q: Where do the IT provisioning files come from?
ORIGIN.A: A file is created for each recruited candidate who must be equipped, from recruitment (for example when their offer is accepted). It stays here until it is marked as completed.

OPEN.Q: How do I work on a file?
OPEN.A: Click its card (or its row in list view): the file opens in 6 steps, Identity, Microsoft 365, Hardware, Licenses, Active Directory and Notes & Finalization.

OVERDUE.A: The employee's expected start date has passed and the file is not completed. The card shows the days of delay; the « Overdue only » filter shows only those.

INCOMPLETE.Q: What do « Incomplete hardware » and « Incomplete licenses » mean?
INCOMPLETE.A: Incomplete hardware: fewer than 6 items marked « Provided ». Incomplete licenses: the 5 licences (Office 365, AutoCAD, Revit, Autodesk, Kaspersky) are not all ticked. This does not prevent completing the file.

MISSING.Q: How do I find files without an MS365 email or hardware?
MISSING.A: Open « Filters », then « Missing items » and pick Hardware, Licences or MS365 email: the list shows the files missing at least one of the chosen items.

DONE.Q: I can't find a completed file. Where is it?
DONE.A: Files marked as completed leave this page: find them in « IT Provisioning » › « History ».

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in IT Provisioning kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes, when you open a file and come back: the view, search, filters, sort and page are restored.

WHAT.Q: What does the provisioning history hold?
WHAT.A: All IT files marked as completed, newest first. « Filters » lets you search them by completion date, by who completed them, by AD profile, by position or by start date.

AVG.Q: How is « Average lead time (days) » computed?
AVG.A: It is the average number of days between each file's creation and its completion, over the whole history.

EDIT.Q: Can a completed file be edited?
EDIT.A: Yes: open it, correct the hardware, licences or notes, then « Save ». The completion itself is final, and the MS365 address can no longer be changed.

ORDER.Q: Must the steps be filled in order?
ORDER.A: No. « Next » and « Previous » move step by step, and clicking a step in the « Progress » column goes straight to it. Changing step loses nothing.

SAVE.Q: Is what I enter in the IT file saved automatically?
SAVE.A: No: click « Save draft » before leaving the page, otherwise the hardware, licences, AD and notes you entered are lost. Only the MS365 address is saved separately, with « Submit email ». If you leave the page with unsaved entries, a window warns you.

EMAIL.Q: How do I create the Microsoft 365 account?
EMAIL.A: Step 2: enter the address (firstname.lastname@itecgroupe.com), click « Submit email » then « Confirm creation ». The employee's account is created in DAF360. The action is irreversible: check the address before confirming.

EMAIL_WRONG.Q: I submitted a wrong MS365 email address. What now?
EMAIL_WRONG.A: It can no longer be changed from the file: the account creation is irreversible. Contact a DAF360 administrator to correct it.

HARDWARE.Q: How do I record the hardware handed over (serial number, condition)?
HARDWARE.A: Step 3: tick « Provided » for each item, then fill in the serial number, brand / model, Asset Tag and condition (New, Good condition, Used, Under repair, Defective). Then save with « Save draft ».

NO_HARDWARE.Q: Why does the Hardware step show no equipment?
NO_HARDWARE.A: No hardware type is configured for the employee's entity. Types are configured in the HR administration; ask an administrator.

COMPLETE_DISABLED.Q: Why is « Mark as completed » greyed out?
COMPLETE_DISABLED.A: You first need the MS365 email submitted (step 2) and « Active Directory account created » ticked (step 5). Hardware and licences are not required to complete.

COMPLETE.Q: What does « Mark as completed » do?
COMPLETE.A: It saves what you entered, asks for confirmation, then closes the file for good. The file moves to « History » and the hardware discharge becomes available in step 6.

DISCHARGE.Q: How do I get the hardware discharge?
DISCHARGE.A: Once the file is completed, open step 6 « Notes & Finalization » and click « Generate discharge »: the document records the handover of the hardware to the employee.

ORIGIN.Q: When does an employee reach Onboarding?
ORIGIN.A: After IT provisioning: as soon as their Microsoft 365 address is created, their file shows here (status « Email received », then « HR in progress »), waiting for the HR profile.

OPEN.Q: How do I complete a file?
OPEN.A: Click its card (or its row in list view): the file opens in 8 steps, from Identity to Summary.

DRAFT.Q: What does the « Draft » badge mean?
DRAFT.A: The file was started and a draft was saved. The « Draft » filter separates started files from untouched ones.

LATE.Q: How do I see files whose start date has passed?
LATE.A: Open « Filters » and tick « Start date passed »: only files whose expected start date has passed are shown, to handle first.

TIME.Q: What does « Average creation time » measure?
TIME.A: The average time, in minutes, to fill in and create a file. Under 30 minutes: fast pace; 30 to 60: normal pace; beyond: to optimise.

DONE.Q: Where does the file go once created?
DONE.A: It leaves this list: the employee now has their profile in « Profiles », where the rest is completed (documents, contracts, equipment).

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in Onboarding kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes, when you open a file and come back: the view, search, filters, sort and page are restored.

REQUIRED.Q: Which fields are required to create the onboarding file (contract, regime, CNSS, RIB)?
REQUIRED.A: The hire date and contract type (Position), the work regime (Regime), the social security number (Personal), the RIB and the bank certificate (Bank). If one is missing, a message says so and takes you to the step.

DRAFT.Q: Is what I enter in onboarding saved?
DRAFT.A: Only with « Save Draft »: the date of the last draft shows at the top. Note that the photo and the bank certificate are not kept in the draft: attach them again before submitting. If you leave the page with unsaved entries, a window warns you.

CERTIFICATE.Q: Which file do I attach as the bank certificate?
CERTIFICATE.A: A PDF, JPG or PNG of 10 MB at most, in the Bank step. It is saved when the file is created, as the RIB document of the employee's profile.

CONTRACT.Q: How do I attach the signed contract?
CONTRACT.A: In the Contract step, drop the PDF (10 MB at most) in « Signed contract »: it is sent to the file right away.

SALARY.Q: Are the salary and notice period taken from the offer?
SALARY.A: Yes, in the Contract step they are prefilled from the offer: correct them if needed. The notice period is locked on the contract at validation; to change it later, a new contract is needed from the profile.

READONLY.Q: Why can't I change the work email or the PC?
READONLY.A: This information comes from IT provisioning and is read-only here. To correct it, go through the employee's IT file.

PHOTO.Q: How do I pick the profile photo during onboarding?
PHOTO.A: Click the camera icon under the photo, on the left (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 3 MB at most). It is only saved when the file is created.

SUBMIT.Q: What happens when I submit the file (welcome email)?
SUBMIT.A: After confirmation, the employee's profile is officially created and a welcome email goes to their Microsoft 365 address. It is irreversible. A confirmation page then offers « View employee profile ».

UPLOAD_FAILED.Q: The file was created but an attachment failed. What now?
UPLOAD_FAILED.A: The profile does exist: add the photo or the bank certificate from the employee's profile, « Documents » tab for the certificate.

NO_REGIME.Q: Why is no work regime offered?
NO_REGIME.A: No regime is configured for the employee's country. Regimes are configured in the HR administration; ask an administrator.

START.Q: How do I start an offboarding?
START.A: From the employee's profile: « Start offboarding » at the bottom of their identity card, then the departure type. The file then opens and shows on this page.

COLUMNS.Q: Why can't I drag the offboarding kanban cards?
COLUMNS.A: The columns are derived from the file's tasks: a card changes column as its tasks move on. Open the file to move it forward.

BLOCKED.Q: What does « Blocked » mean on a departure file?
BLOCKED.A: A mandatory task is blocked or overdue. Open the file: the stage concerned shows « Action required ». Finishing its tasks unblocks the file.

SLA.A: One or more of the file's tasks are past their planned deadline. There is nothing else to do than finish the late tasks; the « Late or SLA breached only » filter groups them.

RESIGNATION.Q: Why doesn't the « Resignation » page show every departure?
RESIGNATION.A: It only shows departures whose reason is resignation, counters included. The full Offboarding list shows every reason (end of contract, dismissal, retirement…) and offers a reason filter.

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in Offboarding kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes, when you open a file and come back: the view, search, filters, sort and page are restored.

LOCKED.Q: Why is a stage of the departure file locked?
LOCKED.A: Stages 3 to 7 stay locked until the Declaration (last working day) and the HR Validation are done. The « next » button at the bottom says so.

RESERVED.Q: Why do I see « Stage reserved » instead of the content?
RESERVED.A: This stage is held by another department (manager, IT, finance or HR) and you don't have the right to work on it. The department is named; ask it to handle the stage.

TASK.Q: How do I finish or skip an offboarding task?
TASK.A: On the task, « Complete » opens a window with an optional comment, then « Mark as done ». « Skip », only for non-blocking tasks, asks for a reason.

LAST_DAY.Q: How do I enter the last working day?
LAST_DAY.A: Declaration stage: « Complete the declaration », then the last working day (required), the notice waiver, the supporting document (PDF, JPG or PNG) and notes, and « Save the declaration ».

VALIDATION.Q: Who validates the departure: manager decision then HR validation?
VALIDATION.A: First the manager gives their decision (« Record the manager's decision »; HR can enter it for them). Then HR validates (« Validate (HR) ») with the final end date and the notice paid but not worked, which affects the final settlement.

HANDOVER.Q: How do I organise the handover (successor, minutes)?
HANDOVER.A: Handover stage: « Name a successor », pick the handover start, tick the checklist items and upload or write the handover minutes.

ASSETS.Q: How do I record the equipment return?
ASSETS.A: IT & equipment stage: tick each item returned and give its condition (« Confirm the return »; it can't be undone). « Sync from IT » picks up the employee's equipment. Then « Generate discharge form ».

EXIT_INTERVIEW.Q: How do I do the exit interview?
EXIT_INTERVIEW.A: HR management & documents stage: « Schedule » (date and time), then after the interview « Record the outcome » (date, reasons, feedback). The interview task completes by itself when saved.

SETTLEMENT.Q: How do I compute and validate the final settlement?
SETTLEMENT.A: Payroll stage: « Propose the lines » (automatic prorata) or « Add a line », check the net total and the payment date, then « Validate settlement ». It stays greyed out while a blocking task is open elsewhere, such as the equipment return.

CLOSE.Q: How do I close a departure file?
CLOSE.A: « Validate offboarding » (at the top or in the Closure stage), then confirm. The file is locked and the employee's profile moves to « Terminated ». No blocking task may be left open.

CANCEL.Q: How do I cancel an offboarding?
CANCEL.A: « Cancel » button at the top of the file, then « Confirm cancellation » (a reason is optional). The employee's profile goes back to active.

REOPEN.Q: Can a departure file be reopened or archived?
REOPEN.A: Yes. « Reopen » restarts a validated or cancelled file (a reason is required). « Archive » removes a validated file from the lists without deleting it; an archived file can no longer be reopened.

HISTORY.Q: Where do I see the action history of a departure file?
HISTORY.A: « History » button at the top of the file: the list of every action, with « Download the full log » as CSV.

APPROVE.Q: How do I approve a leave request?
APPROVE.A: On the pending request, « Approve »: the window recalls how many days will be debited from the employee's balance. Confirm with « Approve ». If the balance is too low, the error message says so.

REFUSE.Q: How do I reject a leave request?
REFUSE.A: « Reject », then enter the « Reason for rejection » (required): it is sent to the employee. Confirm with « Reject ».

BULK.Q: How do I approve several leave requests at once?
BULK.A: With the « Pending » status, « Approve all » takes the whole filtered queue; in « Table » view you can also tick rows. A window sums up the number of requests and the filters. A low balance doesn't stop the others: failures are listed at the end.

BALANCE.Q: Where do I see the employee's leave balance?
BALANCE.A: Open the request in « To handle »: the detail shows « Employee's balances » (leave, sick, remote work), with the balance this type uses highlighted.

MISSING.Q: Why don't I see a leave request?
MISSING.A: « To handle » only shows the requests you are the manager or deputy for, and opens on the « Pending » status: pick « All » in « Filter » to also see requests already handled.

UNDO.Q: Can a leave approval be undone?
UNDO.A: Not from « To handle »: approving and rejecting are final. On « All leave », « Archive » on an approved request removes it from the lists and credits its days back (depending on your rights).

DAYS.Q: How are leave days counted (holidays, half days)?
DAYS.A: They are computed automatically, without the country's weekends or public holidays. A half day counts as 0.5 day.

OWN.Q: How do I request my own leave?
OWN.A: Not here: your own request is filed from your personal DAF360 space (self-service). The Leave pages of the HR module are for handling other people's requests.

HOW.Q: How do I file a leave on an employee's behalf?
HOW.A: « Back-dated entries » page: « New entry », pick the employee (their types, balances and managers depend on them), the leave type, duration, dates, manager, supporting document if asked and the reason for the entry, then « File entry ».

APPROVAL.Q: Is a back-dated entry approved straight away?
APPROVAL.A: No. It is created as « Pending » and goes to the chosen manager, like any request. It is only approved after their decision.

PROOF.Q: When is a supporting document needed for a back-dated entry?
PROOF.A: When the leave type requires it: the « Supporting document » field then appears and becomes required (PDF or photo JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, 10 MB at most). It is filed in the employee's SharePoint folder.

CALENDAR.Q: Why are some days greyed out in the back-dated entry calendar?
CALENDAR.A: Public holidays and days the employee already has leave on can't be picked. Some types are also capped: the form then shows the maximum number of days.

NO_APPROVER.Q: What if the form says no manager holds the approver role?
NO_APPROVER.A: The leave type requires an approval role that none of this employee's managers holds. The leave type must be corrected in the administration (Leave types) before filing the request.

MINE.Q: What does the « My entries » / « Everyone's entries » button do?
MINE.A: It switches the list between your own entries (by default) and everyone's. The button shows the view it switches to, not the current one.

WHO.A: Every employee below you in the role hierarchy. The page is for viewing their history: to approve or reject, go through « To handle ».

STATES.Q: What do the statuses of a leave request mean?
STATES.A: « Pending »: waiting for a decision. « Approved »: accepted, the days are debited from the balance. « Rejected »: refused, with a reason. « Archived »: removed from the active lists (nothing is ever deleted).

PROOF.Q: How do I see a leave's supporting document?
PROOF.A: Click the request: in the detail, « Open the document » opens it in a new tab. « Not provided » means no file was attached.

WHO.A: Every request in the countries your role covers, whoever the manager. It is the only page where a request can be archived.

ARCHIVE.Q: How do I archive a leave request?
ARCHIVE.A: On « All leave », « Archive » on the request, then confirm. It leaves the active lists; if it was approved, its days are credited back to the employee. Archiving can't be undone.

TYPES.A: In the HR administration, « Leave types » tab: caps, required supporting document, approving roles… An administration right is needed.

WHAT.Q: What does the request inbox hold?
WHAT.A: Every HR request of your entity still open: « Submitted », « In progress » and « Awaiting L2 ». Approved, rejected or cancelled requests are in the request history.

NEW.Q: How do I create an HR or hiring request?
NEW.A: Requests are filed from the personal DAF360 space (self-service): HR request (certificate, address change, training…) or hiring request. These pages are for handling them.

URGENCY.Q: How is a request's urgency computed?
URGENCY.A: From the submission date, with a 3-day deadline: « On track », then « To handle soon », then « Urgent » once the deadline has passed. The « Urgency » filter isolates them.

APPROVE.Q: How do I approve an HR request?
APPROVE.A: From the list, « Approve the request » then « Approve » (the comment « Approuvé » is added). Or open the request, enter a comment and click « Approve ».

REFUSE.Q: How do I reject an HR request?
REFUSE.A: Not from the list: open the request (« View detail »), enter the « Comment » (required) then « Reject ». The decision is final.

CANCEL.Q: Who can cancel an HR request?
CANCEL.A: Only the requester, and only while it is « Submitted »: « Cancel request ». A request in progress or closed can no longer be cancelled.

STATUSES.Q: What do the HR request statuses mean?
STATUSES.A: « Submitted »: filed (still cancellable). « In progress »: being handled. « Awaiting L2 »: waiting for the second validation, by finance. Then « Approved », « Rejected » or « Cancelled ».

RECRUIT_VALIDATE.Q: Where do I approve a hiring request?
RECRUIT_VALIDATE.A: In the inbox, « Recruitment » tab (with the right to approve hiring): « Approve » or « Reject », with a required reason to reject. Your own request must be approved by someone else.

MEMORY.Q: Are my search and filters in Requests kept?
MEMORY.A: Yes, when you open a request and come back: the tab, search, filters, sort and page are restored.

DECIDE.Q: How do I handle an HR request from its detail?
DECIDE.A: « Take charge » takes you to the « Processing action » block: enter a comment (required, even to approve), then « Approve » or « Reject ». No confirmation: the decision is final.

L2.A: Some request types need a double validation: HR then finance. After the HR validation, the request waits for the second validation, by finance.

DOCS.Q: Where do I find an HR request's documents?
DOCS.A: In the request's detail: « Attachments » (the requester's files, to download) and « Generated documents » (for example the certificate produced after approval).

WHAT.Q: What does the request history hold?
WHAT.A: The requests already decided. « Request » tab: approved, rejected and cancelled. « Recruitment » tab: approved, rejected, cancelled and closed. Requests still open are in the inbox.

OWN.Q: Why do I only see my own hiring requests?
OWN.A: Without the right to view every hiring request, the history only shows the ones you created.

CANDIDATE.Q: What is an approved hiring request used for?
CANDIDATE.A: It becomes an open position: you pick it in « Hiring request » when creating a candidate, which fills in the position, department and start date. The number of linked candidates shows on the request.

DECIDE.Q: How do I approve or reject a hiring request from its detail?
DECIDE.A: « Process the request » block, shown to an approver on a « Pending » request that isn't theirs: an optional comment, then « Approve » or « Reject ». No confirmation.

CANCEL.Q: How do I cancel a hiring request?
CANCEL.A: Only its creator can, while it is « Pending »: « Cancel this request » in its detail. There is no confirmation.

FIELDS.Q: What does a hiring request contain?
FIELDS.A: The position title, the reason (new position, replacement, increased activity), the description of the need and profile, the urgency level, the headcount (1 to 50), the experience and education level, the start date, the skills and the department.

REQUEST.Q: How do I request a CIVP's move to CDI?
REQUEST.A: From the employee's profile, « Contracts » tab, on their active CIVP contract: « Request move to CDI ». Enter the CDI start date, the proposed monthly net salary, the justification and the evaluation file (required: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB), then « Send request ».

STEPS.Q: What are the steps of a move to CDI?
STEPS.A: 1. « To validate »: the technical and salary validator decides (approve, reject or escalate). 2. « Escalated »: the higher level decides. 3. « Approved — to convert »: HR draws up the CDI contract. 4. « Converted to CDI ».

APPROVE.Q: How do I approve a move-to-CDI request?
APPROVE.A: Open the request, then « Approve ». The comment is optional; you can adjust the net salary and the start date (leaving them empty keeps the proposal). HR is then notified to draw up the contract.

REJECT.Q: How do I reject or escalate a move-to-CDI request?
REJECT.A: Open the request, then « Reject » or « Escalate »: a reason is required. Escalating hands the decision to the higher level; explain what it must decide.

CONVERT.Q: How is the CDI contract drawn up after approval?
CONVERT.A: HR opens the employee's profile (« Open profile »), « Contracts » tab, and clicks « Convert to CDI » on the CIVP contract. The request then becomes « Converted to CDI ».

TODO.Q: What does the « To handle » tab of moves to CDI hold?
TODO.A: What waits for your action, given your role: « To validate » requests for the validator, « Escalated » ones for the arbiter, and approved ones to convert for HR. If it is empty, nothing waits for you.

OWN.Q: Why can't I approve my own move-to-CDI request?
OWN.A: A request is always decided by someone other than the person who filed it (four-eyes check): the decision buttons don't show on your own requests.

CANCEL.Q: How do I cancel a move-to-CDI request?
CANCEL.A: Open the request, then « Cancel request » (optional comment). It is closed without a decision; a new request is still possible.

EVALUATION.Q: Where do I see the CIVP evaluation file?
EVALUATION.A: In the request's detail: « Open the evaluation ». The file is also filed in the employee's folder. Older requests may have none.

CREATE.Q: How do I plan a mission?
CREATE.A: « New mission », then pick the employee, subject, start and end dates, type (national or international), city (and country for an international mission), owner and details. Click « Submit to HR ».

SUBMIT_DISABLED.Q: Why is « Submit to HR » greyed out?
SUBMIT_DISABLED.A: A required field is missing: employee, subject, dates (the end can't be before the start), type and city, the country for an international mission, and an owner (a colleague, or else an external owner).

COSTS.Q: Who enters the mission costs (plane ticket, hotel, allowance)?
COSTS.A: HR, in Ticketing. The manager's form has no costs: until HR enters them, the mission shows « Costs to enter ».

STEPS.Q: What are a mission's validation steps?
STEPS.A: 1. « Awaiting HR »: HR prices the mission then approves or rejects it. 2. « Awaiting finance »: finance approves or rejects it. 3. « Approved ». At each step, a rejection closes the mission.

CANCEL.Q: How do I cancel a mission?
CANCEL.A: While it is « Awaiting HR », click the red « Cancel mission » icon and confirm. Cancelling is final. After HR approval, it is the employee who asks for the cancellation.

LATE.Q: What does « Late » mean on a mission?
LATE.A: The departure date has passed while the mission is still waiting for HR or finance validation. The card shows the number of days late.

TEAM.Q: Why can't I find an employee in the mission form?
TEAM.A: The list only offers your team members: you only plan missions for your own team.

CHANGE.Q: The employee wants to change the dates or cancel their mission: how?
CHANGE.A: They ask from their personal DAF360 space. The mission then shows « Pending request », and HR accepts or rejects it in Ticketing.

DETAIL.Q: Where do I see a mission's costs and history?
DETAIL.A: « View details »: the mission (period, destination, owner), the costs entered by HR with the total estimated cost, any employee request and the history of decisions.

WHAT.Q: What does the mission history hold?
WHAT.A: Closed missions: « Approved », « Rejected by HR », « Rejected by finance » and « Cancelled ». Missions still being validated are in « Current missions ».

REFUSED.A: Open it: the « History » section of the detail shows who rejected it, when, and the reason entered.

PRICE.Q: How do I enter a mission's expenses?
PRICE.A: Ticketing, « To handle » tab: « Fill in the expenses » on the mission. Pick the currency, then fill in the allowance and amount, lodging, transport, additional costs and advance. « Save expenses »; you can come back to it before approving.

ALLOWANCE.Q: How is the mission allowance computed?
ALLOWANCE.A: Enter the allowance per day: the « Apply » button offers allowance × number of mission days. It is never applied automatically; you can enter another amount.

TOTAL.Q: What does a mission's « Total estimated cost » include?
TOTAL.A: The allowance, lodging, ticket, visa, insurance and other costs. The advance paid to the employee is not added to the total.

VALIDATE.Q: Why can't I approve a mission in Ticketing?
VALIDATE.A: Approval is only possible once the expenses are entered: save the expenses first. Then « Approve and send to finance » sends the mission to finance, which makes the final decision.

REJECT.Q: How do I reject a mission?
REJECT.A: « Reject the mission », then enter the « Reason for rejection » (required) and confirm. The mission becomes « Rejected by HR »; it is final.

REQUESTS.Q: How do I handle a mission change or cancellation request?
REQUESTS.A: « Requests » tab: « Accept the request » moves or cancels the mission straight away (without confirmation); « Refuse the request » asks for a reason. Check the requested period and the reason before accepting.

LATE.A: Missions whose departure date has passed are still waiting for you. The card shows the days late: handle them first.

ACCESS.A: Administrators and HR managers. Each sees only the sections they have the right to; other users see « Access denied ».

COUNTRY.Q: How do I configure another entity (country)?
COUNTRY.A: If you manage several entities, « Change country » at the top of Administration switches to another. Most settings (holidays, regimes, lists…) are specific to each entity.

FIND.Q: Where do I find a section of Administration?
FIND.A: Each Administration card is a section: Access and accounts (Roles & Permissions, Users); Working time and leave (Public holidays, Entity calendar, Work regimes, Breaks, Overtime, Leave types); Requests and lists (Request types, Configurable lists, Reference data, Interview types); Documents, alerts and settings (Notifications & Emails, Document templates, SharePoint, Contract deadlines, Offboarding tasks, Parameters). Pick it in « Section » to see its questions and its guide.

ROLES.Q: Where do I manage roles and permissions?
ROLES.A: « Roles & Permissions » section: the list of roles and, for each, its information, permissions and users. Permissions are what open the HR module's menus and buttons.

USERS.Q: Where do I manage user accounts?
USERS.A: « Users » section: every account, including those without an HR file or never logged in. You can create a user there (name, email, role, country) and change their leave balances.

HOLIDAYS.Q: Where do I add public holidays?
HOLIDAYS.A: « Public holidays » section, by year, as a table or calendar: « Add », with the « Recurring (every year) » option. They are excluded when counting leave days.

ABSENCE_TYPES.Q: How do I create or edit a leave type?
ABSENCE_TYPES.A: « Leave types » section, « New type »: code (can't be changed afterwards), FR/EN labels, balance used, maximum per request, notice delays, required document, approving roles. « Remove » on a type keeps the requests that use it readable.

REQUEST_TYPES.Q: Where do I configure HR request types?
REQUEST_TYPES.A: « Request types » section: code, labels, category, approval level (L1, or L2 for a double HR + finance validation) and SLA in days. « Initialise the 15 default types » creates the base catalogue.

REF_DATA.Q: Where do I add a grade, a department or a bank?
REF_DATA.A: « Reference data » section: grades, disciplines, NOG levels, departments, banks, nationalities, contract types and IT equipment. A grade's default notice period is set there too.

LISTS.A: They are the forms' choice lists (gender, contract types, AD profiles…). Pick a list, then « Add a value »: code, FR/EN labels and order. System values can't be deleted.

NOTIFICATIONS.Q: How do I configure notifications and emails?
NOTIFICATIONS.A: « Notifications & Emails » section: click an event, turn on the in-app notification and/or the email, write the templates, pick the recipients (TO, CC, BCC), then « Test the configuration ». Without a « TO » recipient, the email is not sent.

OFFBOARDING_TASKS.Q: Where do I define an offboarding's tasks?
OFFBOARDING_TASKS.A: « Offboarding tasks » section: the tasks created for each departure, by contract type, with the owner role, the SLA, the order, and whether they are mandatory or blocking.

CONTRACT_ALERTS.Q: How do I get warned of contract and probation ends?
CONTRACT_ALERTS.A: « Contract deadlines » section: pick how many days before the end of a contract or probation the alert goes out (365 at most). « Run the check now » triggers it right away.

WORK_TIME.Q: Where do I configure work regimes, breaks and overtime?
WORK_TIME.A: In the « Work regimes » (catalogue, role assignment), « Breaks », « Overtime » and « Entity calendar » (weekly rest days) sections.

DOCUMENTS.Q: Where do I change the certificate templates and SharePoint storage?
DOCUMENTS.A: « Document templates » for the templates of generated documents (with « PDF preview »), and « SharePoint » for the filing paths and the diagnostic.

INTERVIEW_TYPES.Q: How do I add an interview type?
INTERVIEW_TYPES.A: « Interview types » section: « New type », with the name in French and English, the order and a description. Without an active type, no interview can be scheduled on a candidate's page.

CREATE.Q: How do I create a role?
CREATE.A: Administration, « Roles & Permissions » card, « New role »: the name (required), the English name, the parent role and the country scope, then « Create role ». The role opens: tick its permissions in the « Permissions » tab.

PERMISSIONS.Q: How do I add or remove a permission for a role?
PERMISSIONS.A: Open the role, « Permissions » tab: each box you tick or untick is saved at once. After « Select all » or « Deselect all », click « Save all ».

ASSIGN.Q: How do I assign a role to a user?
ASSIGN.A: Open the role, « Users » tab, « Add a user »: search by name or email, then « Assign ». A user has only one role: assigning it here replaces their current role.

SCOPE.Q: What is a role's country scope for?
SCOPE.A: It sets which entities' data the role's holders see: their own country, a chosen list of countries, or all countries. It is set in the role's « Information » tab.

PARENT.Q: What is the parent role for?
PARENT.A: It places the role in the hierarchy: holders of the parent role are the managers of this role's holders, for instance to approve their leave or receive notifications sent to the « manager ».

DELETE.Q: Why can't I delete a role?
DELETE.A: A role assigned to active users can't be deleted: the button stays greyed out. Give them another role or remove it from them (« Users » tab), then « Delete this role » in the « Information » tab.

RENAME.Q: Can I rename a role that is already assigned?
RENAME.A: Yes: change the name in the « Information » tab, then « Save ». If users hold the role, a confirmation is asked (« Rename anyway »); their permissions don't change.

CHANGE_DELAY.Q: How do I change the alert lead time before a CDD ends?
CHANGE_DELAY.A: Administration, « Contract deadlines » card: pencil of the CDD row, « Contract end (days before) », then « Save ». The lead time applies to the selected entity.

RECIPIENTS.Q: Who receives the contract-end and trial-end alerts?
RECIPIENTS.A: Recipients and wording are set in Administration, « Notifications & Emails », events « Contract expiry » and « Trial period ending ». This card only sets the number of days.

NO_RECIPIENT.Q: Why does an alert stay « with no recipient »?
NO_RECIPIENT.A: The matching notification rule found nobody to notify for this entity. The alert stays pending and goes out again on the next run: check the rule and its recipients in « Notifications & Emails ».

CDI.Q: Why is there no contract-end alert for a CDI?
CDI.A: A CDI has no end date: its « Contract end » lead time has no effect. Only the trial-end alert applies to it.

DEFAULTS.Q: What does « Defaults » mean on a deadlines row?
DEFAULTS.A: No configuration is saved for this contract type in the entity. Open the row with the pencil and click « Save » to give it its own lead times.

ADD_PATH.Q: How do I set up the SharePoint path of a document kind?
ADD_PATH.A: « Paths by country » tab, « New path »: the country id, the document kind, « Browse » to pick the folder, append the {employeeFolder} token, then « Save ».

FOLDER_MISSING.Q: Why is an employee shown as « Folder missing »?
FOLDER_MISSING.A: Their SharePoint folder does not follow the expected naming convention. « Diagnose » on their row shows the path looked for; « Pin folder » then stores the folder's exact name, checked in SharePoint before saving.

REQUIRED_DOCS.Q: How do I choose the required documents of an employee's dossier?
REQUIRED_DOCS.A: « Required documents » tab: pick the country and switch on « Required » for each document. Give each one its own path under « Paths by country », otherwise the sync does not read it.

SYNC_NOW.Q: How do I run the SharePoint sync without waiting for the night?
SYNC_NOW.A: « Required documents » tab, « Sync now ». If a sync is already running, the screen follows that one; the summary shows when it ends.

FORCE.Q: The folder is fixed in SharePoint but the employee still fails: what should I do?
FORCE.A: A failure is remembered for 24 h. « Diagnostics » tab, enter the profile id and click « Force », or use « Reset » on their row under « Employee mapping ».

CREATE.Q: How do I create a document template?
CREATE.A: Administration, « Document templates » card, « New template »: name, category and HTML content (required), then « Create ». « Template » inserts a sample work certificate to adapt.

VARIABLES.Q: How do I insert the employee's name or another variable into a template?
VARIABLES.A: In the editor, click the variable under « Available variables »: it is inserted at the cursor, between double braces (for example employee.fullName). It is replaced with the real data at generation time.

PREVIEW.Q: How do I see a template's PDF preview before saving it?
PREVIEW.A: « PDF preview », in the editor, opens the PDF in a new tab. Without an « Employee profile ID », variables are filled with sample data; with one, with that employee's data.

NOT_USED.Q: Why doesn't my generated certificate use my template?
NOT_USED.A: Generation looks for the entity's active template bearing exactly the document's name (for example « Attestation de Travail »). If the name differs or the template is inactive, the built-in standard model is used.

INACTIVE.Q: Where do I find a deactivated template?
INACTIVE.A: Inactive templates are hidden by default: open « Filters » and tick « Show inactive ». The row's switch reactivates the template.

ADD_TASK.Q: How do I add a task to the offboarding catalog?
ADD_TASK.A: Administration, « Offboarding tasks » card: pick the contract type's tab, then « Add a task ». Fill in the code, label, owner role and SLA, then « Add ».

EXISTING_FILE.Q: Why doesn't an already open departure file have my new task?
EXISTING_FILE.A: Tasks are copied from the catalog when the file is opened, according to the employee's contract type. Catalog changes only apply to files opened afterwards.

BLOCKING.Q: What does the « Blocking » option change on a task?
BLOCKING.A: A blocking task cannot be skipped in the file, and the file cannot be validated until it is completed. Without this option, the task can be skipped.

VALIDATOR.Q: Who can give the HR validation of an entity's departures?
VALIDATOR.A: The holders of the role picked in « Departure validator role », and only them. With no designated role, anyone holding the HR offboarding validation or management permission can validate.

DELETE_TASK.Q: Why can't I delete a task from the catalog?
DELETE_TASK.A: The catalog does not delete tasks: the row's switch deactivates it. An inactive task is no longer added to new files and can be reactivated at any time.

CREATE.Q: How do I create an interview type?
CREATE.A: Administration, « Interview types » card, « New type »: the FR label (required), the display order, the EN label and the description, then « Add ». The type is created for the entity picked at the top of Administration.

DEACTIVATE.Q: Why can't I deactivate an interview type?
DEACTIVATE.A: A type still used by scheduled interviews cannot be deactivated: the message says how many. Wait until they are held or cancelled, then try again.

DELETE.Q: Can an interview type be deleted?
DELETE.A: No: a type can only be deactivated, with its row's switch. It is then no longer offered when scheduling, and the switch reactivates it at any time.

ORDER.Q: How do I change the order of the offered interview types?
ORDER.A: Click a type's « Edit » pencil and change its « Display order », then « Save ». Scheduling offers the types in that order.

MISSING.Q: Why doesn't an interview type appear when scheduling?
MISSING.A: Only the active types of the entity concerned are offered. Check its « Active » status and that the entity picked at the top of Administration is the recruitment's one.

NEW_EVENT.Q: Why is there no button to create a notification event?
NEW_EVENT.A: Each event matches a trigger in the code: the technical team adds it. This card sets what happens next (channels, messages, recipients).

RECIPIENTS.Q: How do I choose who receives a notification?
RECIPIENTS.A: Open the event, « In-app recipients » or « Email recipients » section, « Add a role »: in « Target », pick the holders of a role, the manager, the holders of a permission, the person concerned or their manager, then « Add ». It is saved at once.

EMAIL_NOT_SENT.Q: Why isn't an event's email sent?
EMAIL_NOT_SENT.A: Check that « Email » is on and saved with « Save templates », and that there is at least one « To (TO) » recipient: without one, the email is not sent. If the « Email » switch is greyed out, this event does not support email.

OWN_ACTION.Q: Why don't I get the notification for my own action?
OWN_ACTION.A: The person who triggers the event is removed from the recipients, in-app and by email: you are not notified of your own action. Recipients are also limited to the entity the event concerns.

VARIABLES.Q: How do I put the employee's name in a notification message?
VARIABLES.A: In the templates, click one of the buttons under the field, for example {firstName}, {lastName} or {date}: the variable is added to the text and filled in when sending. Then « Save templates ».

ADD_ENTRY.Q: How do I add a new entry to a reference tab?
ADD_ENTRY.A: Administration, « Reference data » card: pick the tab, then « Add ». Enter at least the FR label, then « Add ». Grades, departments and banks are created for the entity picked at the top of Administration.

DELETE_ENTRY.Q: What happens to a deleted reference entry?
DELETE_ENTRY.A: It is deactivated, not erased: it leaves the list and the offered choices, but the records using it keep it. A system contract type cannot be deleted.

RENAME.Q: How do I fix a reference entry's label?
RENAME.A: This card does not edit entries: add the entry with the right label, then delete the old one. Records using the old one keep it until they are edited.

NOTICE.Q: What is a grade's default notice period for?
NOTICE.A: It is the starting value of the notice negotiation for employees of that grade. The notice actually due is fixed on each contract: changing this default (« Grades » tab, « Edit the default notice period » icon) changes no existing contract.

ENTITY.Q: Why do grades and departments change with the entity?
ENTITY.A: Grades, disciplines, NOG levels, departments and banks belong to each entity: the card shows those of the entity picked at the top of Administration. Nationalities, contract types and IT equipment are shared.

ADD_VALUE.Q: How do I add a choice to an HR drop-down list?
ADD_VALUE.A: Administration, « Configurable lists » card: open the list's tab, then « Add a value ». Enter the code, the FR label, the EN label and the order, then « Save ». The value is offered in forms right away.

DELETE_VALUE.Q: Why can't I delete a list value?
DELETE_VALUE.A: The bin is greyed out for a « System » value, which the application uses. A contract type already given to employees is refused too: deactivate it instead (pencil, untick « Active »).

DEACTIVATE.Q: How do I stop offering a value without erasing it?
DEACTIVATE.A: Click the row's pencil, untick « Active », then click the tick. The value is no longer offered in forms, but the records using it keep it. A « System » value cannot be deactivated.

CODE.Q: Can I change a list value's code?
CODE.A: No: only the labels and the « Active » status can be edited. For another code, add a new value, then deactivate the old one.

ENTITY.Q: Why is a contract type offered only in some entities?
ENTITY.A: « Contract type » is a per-entity list: the « Entity » column shows whether a value applies to « All entities » or only to « This entity ». A value you add is created for the entity picked at the top of Administration.

CREATE.Q: How do I set up a country's overtime?
CREATE.A: Administration, « Overtime » card, « New rule »: the country, the calculation type and, for hour-based types, the work start and end time, then « Save ».

REPLACE.Q: What happens to the old overtime rule when I create a new one?
REPLACE.A: It is deactivated automatically: a country has only one active rule at a time. To simply adjust the current rule, use the pencil on its row instead.

TYPES.Q: What is the difference between « Weekend only », « Outside normal hours » and « Mixed »?
TYPES.A: « Weekend only » counts every hour worked on a rest day. « Outside normal hours » counts time worked before the start time or after the end time. « Mixed » applies the first rule on rest days and the second on working days.

SIMULATE.Q: How do I test the overtime calculation?
SIMULATE.A: In the « Overtime calculation simulator »: the country, the date, the gross hours and the start and end time, then « Simulate ». « Rule applied » shows NONE when the country has no active rule.

RESTDAYS.Q: Where are overtime rest days defined?
RESTDAYS.A: In the « Entity calendar » card: they are the country's weekend days. The simulator shows whether the chosen date is a rest day.

CREATE.Q: How do I create a break template?
CREATE.A: « Break templates » tab, « New template »: the working schedule, the label, the type, the duration in minutes, the days, then an hours threshold or a time range, and « Save ».

TYPES.Q: What is the difference between the AUTO, MANDATORY and OPTIONAL types?
TYPES.A: AUTO and MANDATORY are deducted from working time as soon as their conditions (days, threshold or time range) are met. OPTIONAL is never deducted automatically.

LEGAL.Q: What are legal break rules for?
LEGAL.A: They enforce a minimum deduction across the whole entity, based on the hours worked that day, during their effective period. They complement templates: a rule is skipped if a break already deducted that day reaches its duration.

EDIT.Q: How do I fix a break template or rule?
EDIT.A: They cannot be edited: delete the row with the bin, then create it again with « New template » or « New rule ».

WEEKEND.Q: Which days count as « Weekend » for breaks?
WEEKEND.A: The entity's rest days, set in the « Entity calendar » card. « Working days » means the other days.

CREATE.Q: How do I create a working schedule?
CREATE.A: « Catalog » tab, « New regime »: the code, the French label, the hours per week, the timezone and the « Flexible » and « Default regime » options, then « Create regime ». It opens on the right to complete days, times and seasonal period.

ROLE.Q: How do I assign a regime to a role?
ROLE.A: « Role assignment » tab, « Assign » button on the role's row: the regime, the effective date, an end date or « No end date », then « Confirm assignment ». The role's employees without a personal regime follow it.

OVERRIDE.Q: How do I give an employee a personal regime?
OVERRIDE.A: « Overview » tab, pencil on the employee's row, « Set a personal override »: the regime, the effective date, the end date or « No end » and the reason, then « Confirm ». It outranks their role's regime.

DELETE.Q: Why can't I delete a regime?
DELETE.A: The bin stays greyed out while employees have it as a personal regime, a role is assigned to it, or it is the default regime. Remove those assignments, or pick another default regime, then delete it.

TIMEZONE.Q: Why doesn't automatic pointage work in an entity?
TIMEZONE.A: Check the entity's timezone at the top of the « Working schedules » card: without one, pointage automation is off. Pick a timezone (for example Africa/Tunis), then « Save ».

CREATE.Q: How do I add a new HR request type?
CREATE.A: Administration, « Request types » card, « Add »: the code, the French and English labels, the category, the approval level and the SLA, then « Create ». The code must be unique within the entity.

INIT.Q: Why does « Initialize defaults » add nothing?
INIT.A: Initialization only fills entities that have no type yet, even an inactive one. If your entity already has a catalogue, add the missing types with « Add ».

APPROVAL.Q: What is the difference between L1 and L2 approval?
APPROVAL.A: With L1, one approval is enough. With L2, a request approved once waits for a second approval before it is approved. A rejection at any level closes the request.

SLA.Q: What is a type's SLA for?
SLA.A: It is the expected processing time, in days. When an open request exceeds one and a half times that time, a delay alert is sent to the HR manager.

DEACTIVATE.Q: How do I remove a type from the catalogue?
DEACTIVATE.A: Click the « Deactivate » switch on its row, then confirm. The type is no longer offered to employees and leaves the list; requests already made keep it. It cannot be reactivated from this screen.

WEEKEND.Q: How do I change an entity's rest days?
WEEKEND.A: « Entity calendar » card, the calendar icon on the entity's row: choose its weekly rest days, then « Save ». These days are never charged against a leave.

ASSUMED.A: No rest day is recorded for this entity: the calculation falls back to Saturday and Sunday without anyone having chosen them. Open its calendar: Saturday and Sunday are pre-selected, and « Save » confirms them or records the real rest days.

MISSING.Q: Why is an entity missing from the entity calendar?
MISSING.A: Only entities with at least one employee or with rest days already recorded are listed. An entity with nobody in it appears once an employee is attached to it.

NONE.Q: Can an entity be saved with no rest day at all?
NONE.A: No: at least one day is required, and « Save » stays greyed out without it. With none, the calculation would silently fall back to Saturday/Sunday — it would not mean « works 7 days a week ».

DELAYS.Q: Where are notice periods and gaps between two leaves set?
DELAYS.A: Not in the entity calendar: the notice and the gap after a leave are set per leave type, in Administration, « Leave types » card.

CREATE.Q: How do I create a leave type?
CREATE.A: « Leave types » card, « New type »: the code, the FR and EN labels, then the balance, notice periods, rules and approver roles, and « Save ». The code cannot be changed afterwards.

CODE.Q: Why can't a leave type's code be changed?
CODE.A: Every request already filed stores that code: changing it would cut the request off from its type. The code is therefore permanent; for a different code, create a new type and deactivate the old one.

RETIRE.Q: What is the difference between deactivating and retiring a type?
RETIRE.A: Deactivating (the switch) removes it from the choices for a new request, but it stays in the catalogue and comes back with one click. Retiring removes it from the catalogue: existing requests stay readable, but its code can no longer be reused.

BALANCE.Q: How do I make a leave type debit a balance?
BALANCE.A: Open the type (pencil), switch on « Draws on a balance » and pick « Which balance »: CONGE, MALADIE or TELETRAVAIL, then « Save ». The balances themselves are entered per employee in the « Users » card.

NOTICE.Q: How do I set a notice period for a leave type?
NOTICE.A: In the type, « Notice before the leave starts » and « Gap after a previous leave », in working days. Empty, the entity's default value applies: no screen sets it, so enter the delay you want in the type to control it. Enter 0 to set no rule for this type.

ADD.Q: How do I add a public holiday?
ADD.A: « Public holidays » card, « Add » (or a click on a free day in « Calendar » view): the date, the French and English labels, « Recurring (every year) » if the holiday comes back on the same date, then « Create ».

DATE.Q: How do I change a public holiday's date?
DATE.A: Editing a public holiday changes only its labels and its recurrence. For another date, delete it (bin) and create it again with « Add ».

RECURRING.Q: What does « Recurring » mean for a public holiday?
RECURRING.A: A recurring public holiday comes back every year on the same day and month in the leave count, without being entered again. Leave it unticked for a holiday whose date moves from year to year, such as Eid: enter it each year instead.

YEAR.Q: Why is a public holiday missing from the list?
YEAR.A: The list and the calendar show the public holidays dated in the current year. A recurring holiday saved in an earlier year does not appear, but it still counts every year in the leave count.

ENTITY.Q: How do I manage another entity's public holidays?
ENTITY.A: The holidays shown are those of the entity named in the Administration header. « Switch country » moves to another entity within your scope; an entity outside your scope is refused.

ADD.Q: How do I add a payroll parameter?
ADD.A: « Payroll settings » card, « Add »: enter the key (for example TAUX_CNSS_EMPLOYE), the value and, if needed, a description, then « Create ». The parameter is added to the entity shown in the header; the same key cannot be created twice there.

SEED.A: It creates the default payroll parameters (Tunisian values for Tunisia, Egyptian values for other countries) in every entity that has none yet. An entity that already has at least one parameter is left unchanged.

SEED_EMPTY.Q: Why does initialization add no parameter?
SEED_EMPTY.A: Initialization skips any entity that already holds a parameter, including the public holiday calendar settings, stored in the same place but hidden here. Add the payroll parameters one by one with « Add » instead.

KEY.Q: Can I rename a parameter's key?
KEY.A: No: editing a row changes only the value. For a different key, delete the parameter (bin) and create it again with « Add ».

ENTITY.Q: How do I see another entity's payroll settings?
ENTITY.A: The parameters shown are those of the entity named in the Administration header. Click « Switch country » to move to another entity within your scope.

CREATE.Q: How do I create a user account?
CREATE.A: Administration, « Users » card, « New account »: the full name, email, role and entity, then « Create ». The account has no HR file: it shows « No HR file » until an employee file exists.

LOGIN.Q: Why can't a new user sign in?
LOGIN.A: Sign-in goes through Azure AD on the account's email address. Until an Azure account exists with exactly the same address, the person cannot sign in: check the email entered or have the Azure account created.

BALANCE.Q: How do I change an employee's leave balances?
BALANCE.A: « Users » card, the calendar icon on their row (or « Edit balances » in Cards view): enter the leave, sick and remote-work balances, then « Save ». An empty field means « not recorded »; 0 means « no days left ».

TECHNICAL.Q: What is a technical account for?
TECHNICAL.A: It is an account that is not a person (test, import, service). It appears in no list of people and among no notification recipients, but it stays active. The person icon on a table row reclassifies an account either way.

SYNC.Q: What does the « Synchronize » button do?
SYNC.A: It pushes account state to finance and payroll right away, without waiting for the automatic reconciliation (within 15 minutes). If a module does not answer, the change stays saved and will be picked up automatically.

WHAT.Q: What is the difference between the candidate list and the Candidates board?
WHAT.A: The « Candidates » board arranges ongoing applications by stage (Screening, Interview, Offer, Recruited). The list is a register of every candidate, all statuses, as a table page by page.

REACH.Q: How do I open the candidate list?
REACH.A: It is not in the menu: open the address /rh/candidates/list, or the « Open » button in « Help & guides ». A candidate page opened from the list brings you back through its breadcrumb.

HISTORY.Q: Where do I see a candidate's decision history?
HISTORY.A: In the candidate list, click their row: a panel opens on the right with the decision history.

WHEN.Q: When is the « New HR profile » page used?
WHEN.A: For someone who already has a DAF360 account but no HR profile: in « Profiles », their « Create HR profile » icon opens this page. Usually the profile is rather created by recruitment and onboarding.

REQUIRED.Q: Which fields are needed to create an HR profile?
REQUIRED.A: The full name, country, contract type and hire date; the end date too for a fixed-term contract. The position, photo and contact are optional and completed later.

AFTER.Q: What happens to the profile after « Create record »?
AFTER.A: It opens straight in edit mode to complete the rest, with the « Pre-onboarding » status. In the « Profiles » list, tick « Include departed profiles » to find it, or move it to « Active ».

WHAT.Q: What do I do after « File created successfully »?
WHAT.A: The employee's profile exists and the welcome email has gone. « View employee profile » opens their profile to complete the rest (documents, contracts, equipment); « Back to list » returns to Onboarding.

WELCOME.TEXT: This page follows applications step by step: Screening, Interview, Offer and Recruited. The « New Candidate » button, top right, adds a candidate (depending on your rights). Follow this guide to discover the page.

KPIS.TITLE: The counters
KPIS.TEXT: « Total Candidates » (with the rate of closed hirings), « Avg. Recruitment Time » (over 30 days, it misses the target) and « Urgent Positions », the applications whose start date is close. Search and filters don't change them.

TOOLBAR.TITLE: Search, filters and display
TOOLBAR.TEXT: Search looks at the name, position, email, location and skills. « Filters » lets you pick a stage, a position (a recruitment demand or « Unsolicited application »), a minimum fit score or urgent ones only. The two icons on the right switch between kanban and list view.

BOARD.TITLE: The stages
BOARD.TEXT: Four columns: Screening, Interview, Offer and Recruited. A candidate who already has an interview scheduled shows under « Interview ». In each column, candidates are sorted by « Fit » score; the header arrow reverses the order. Click a card to open the candidate's page.

ACTIONS.TITLE: Card actions
ACTIONS.TEXT: Under Interview, an accepted candidate has the « Send an offer » icon. Under Offer, an offer awaiting signature has three icons: « Accept the offer » (the candidate moves to IT provisioning), « Renegotiate » and « Refuse the offer » (a reason is required). « Send an offer » and « Renegotiate » open the « Offer » tab of the candidate's page.

END.TITLE: You're all set!
